about: CuciVM system catalogue. The app reads this file from GitHub and falls back to the copy built into the APK. 'app_space' entries need no download: the engine is built into the app. Files over 2 GB: list them in 'parts' (each under 2 GB, joined in order) or point 'url' at an official mirror. Logos are links to their official/Commons sources, not copies.

images.name: Debian 13 · XFCE + Firefox
images.setup: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && A='-o APT::Sandbox::User=root' && apt-get $A update && apt-get $A install -y --no-install-recommends tigervnc-standalone-server xfce4 xfce4-terminal dbus-x11 fonts-dejavu-core tzdata ca-certificates firefox-esr mousepad ristretto

images.name: Programmi Windows · Wine + Box64
images.setup:
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && A='-o APT::Sandbox::User=root' && apt-get $A update && apt-get $A install -y --no-install-recommends tigervnc-standalone-server xfce4 xfce4-terminal dbus-x11 fonts-dejavu-core tzdata ca-certificates box64 wget xz-utils libx11-6 libxext6 libxrender1 libxrandr2 libxi6 libxcursor1 libxcomposite1 libxinerama1 libfreetype6 libfontconfig1 libgl1 libgnutls30t64 libvulkan1 libasound2t64 libdbus-1-3 && wget -qO /tmp/wine.tar.xz https://github.com/Kron4ek/Wine-Builds/releases/download/11.20/wine-11.20-amd64-wow64.tar.xz && echo '482a493c755dcea776199b86560e0fb0f969bb0275c67d88120b0b35b0df34b9  /tmp/wine.tar.xz' | sha256sum -c - && tar -xJf /tmp/wine.tar.xz -C /opt && rm -rf /opt/wine && mv /opt/wine-11.20-amd64-wow64 /opt/wine && rm /tmp/wine.tar.xz && printf '#!/bin/sh
exec box64 /opt/wine/bin/wine "$@"
' > /usr/local/bin/wine && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/wine && mkdir -p /root/Desktop && printf '[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=Windows: Esplora risorse
Exec=wine explorer
Icon=system-file-manager
' > /root/Desktop/wine-explorer.desktop && printf '[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=Windows: Blocco note
Exec=wine notepad
Icon=accessories-text-editor
' > /root/Desktop/wine-notepad.desktop && chmod +x /root/Desktop/*.desktop
